reason: A DeepSeek Harness diagnostic and repair utility that checks runtime and project state, applies scoped reversible fixes, monitors plugin lifecycle status, and supports rollback; full repair may install dependencies and stop residual processes.

summaries.zh: 用于诊断 DeepSeek Harness 环境、按范围修复配置与依赖问题、监控运行状态并支持回滚的命令行插件。
summaries.en: A command-line plugin for diagnosing DeepSeek Harness environments, applying scoped repairs to configuration and dependencies, monitoring runtime status, and rolling back recorded changes.

capabilities: Read environment, profile, configuration, bundle, mount, port, health, and disk state
Modify files and configuration during repair operations
Install or repair dependencies with pnpm
Stop residual processes in full repair mode
Monitor plugin lifecycle status at runtime
Record repair journals and perform rollback operations
